machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service health" (folder Bench, UID `bench-service-health`, URL `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has exactly 3 panels, titled as displayed: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard created and saved, titled **fwgr50-n1 Bench Dashboard**, containing a Stat panel titled **fwgr50-n1 Availability** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (selected from the query editor's data source picker; default random-walk scenario). The panel renders live values (e.g. 56.0, 38.2, 50.0, 106 across reloads), confirming the TestData source is active.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a Text panel titled **fwgr50-n1 Notes** with rendered content **"Notes for run fwgr50-n1"** (contains the runid). Saved — verified after a fresh page reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard has the tag **bench** (verified as a tag chip in Dashboard settings > General > Tags, with a "Remove \"bench\" tag" button, after a fresh page load) and its saved default time range is **Last 6 hours**. The save drawer's "Update default time range" checkbox was ticked (DOM `checked === true`) before saving; persistence was proven by loading the dashboard URL with no time params in the URL and seeing the picker read "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is **1m**. The save drawer's "Update default refresh value" checkbox was ticked before saving ("Dashboard saved" confirmation). Verified after a fresh full page load: the refresh button reads "1m" with aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's address bar on a fresh page load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfygwul6n56o0c/fwgr50-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: **bfygwul6n56o0c**. (The `from=now-6h&refresh=1m` params were written by Grafana itself from the saved defaults, not typed by me.)

Final state confirmed on the live page: breadcrumb "Home / Dashboards / fwgr50-n1 Bench Dashboard", page title "fwgr50-n1 Bench Dashboard - Dashboards - Grafana", two panels ("fwgr50-n1 Notes" and "fwgr50-n1 Availability"), time picker "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m", tag "bench" in settings.
